title: Wendell and the Signal
author: Ulyana Yarrow
blurb: Mirabel Voss, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
